title: Zesty American Chicken Sandwich
description: A juicy grilled chicken breast topped with a sweet and spicy glaze, served on a pillowy ciabatta roll for a satisfying low‑carb lunch.
instructions: Preheat a tava griddle to medium heat.
Pat the chicken breasts dry and rub them with olive oil, paprika, garlic powder, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper.
Place the seasoned chicken on the hot griddle and cook for 5 minutes on each side or until the internal temperature reaches 165°F.
While the chicken rests, whisk together Dijon mustard, honey, and lemon juice until smooth.
Slice the ciabatta roll horizontally and lightly toast the cut sides on the griddle.
Brush the glaze over both sides of the cooked chicken to coat evenly.
Place the glazed chicken on the toasted roll, then top with shredded lettuce and sliced tomato.
Serve immediately while warm, enjoying the zesty flavors and pillowy texture.
